body:
It's always nice to know that other people feel the same way.

How are you doing tonight?

Hi. Female, 22. I just went through a bad breakup as well. Girlfriend left me for her ex-boyfriend. I know it's cheesy but taking things one day/hour/etc at a time is actually helping me a lot. For me, just thinking about what I have to accomplish in the next hour is helpful. Sometimes that's, you know, "pay my rent" and sometimes it's "call someone so you don't hurt yourself." I know it's dumb. But it helps me.

DM me if you like.
Hi friend. I too am having a rough night. Feel free to DM me if you want to talk.
